integrity: The weighted-chi-square identity, strict joint-versus-contrast threshold comparison, and high-confidence limit are proved from the stated covariance limits. The numerical example is only a reproducibility check. Prior work on generic level-specific scalar calibration and on matrix-valued covariance adjustment is explicitly separated from the originality claim.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic Gaussian-limit result for scalar radial post-processing. It assumes the stated sampling and centered-posterior covariance limits plus consistent covariance estimation for implementation. It gives no finite-sample guarantee and does not analyze plug-in estimation error.
title: Spectral calibration frontier for bagged martingale posterior ellipsoids
